scenarios.name: sdr-resources-active-standby
scenarios.why: the delete-clear of the resources path (SDR): DOCUMENT CREATE / RETRIEVE of template ZC01DC ('type: AS' and the other region's URL), WEB PARSE of the URL, WEB OPEN / CONVERSE DELETE (path from URIMAP ZC01R, query 'clear=*') / CLOSE on the other region, the expired-record browse (ZC01FILE holds no record here: READ GTEQ NOTFND ends it), then 4000: the WEB SEND of CR LF, status 200

scenarios.name: sdr-resources-https
scenarios.why: an https URL: URL-SCHEME HTTPS, port 8443

scenarios.name: sdr-resources-default-port
scenarios.why: no port in the URL: WEB PARSE gives the scheme's default (80)

scenarios.name: sdr-resources-other-region-404
scenarios.why: the other region answers 404: the program does not look at the status

scenarios.name: adr-resources
scenarios.why: CA-TYPE ADR (the other region's request): 1000 sends the response at once; the replication still runs

scenarios.name: adr-replicate
scenarios.why: type ADR on the replicate path: DC-TYPE is set LOW-VALUES, nothing is replicated

scenarios.name: sdr-replicate
scenarios.why: the replicate path: response at once, DC-TYPE LOW-VALUES, no replication; 4000 does not send again

scenarios.name: other-type-resources
scenarios.why: a type that is not SDR or ADR: no response is sent; the replication runs

scenarios.name: other-type-other-path
scenarios.why: neither type nor path matches: nothing sent

notes: zECS's expiration clean-up task for one instance (ZECS003, started by the ZX## transaction, here ZC01: EIBTRNID(3:2) names the instance's files ZC01FILE and ZC01KEY, its URIMAP ZC01R and its document template ZC01DC). Its COMMAREA is CA-TYPE ('ADR' or 'SDR') and CA-URI-FIELD-01 ('/resources' or '/replicate'). The region's facts are stated on both sides: the document template ZC01DC as the document holds it ("doctemplates", oracle_assumptions.md X33, APPENDCRLF applied: 'type: <AA|AS|A1>' CR LF, the other region's URL, CR LF; zECS's own template is ZC##DC.txt), the URIMAP definitions ("urimaps", X32), the other region's HTTP server ("http_peers", X35) and the inbound request the WEB SEND answers ("http_request", X37). HOLES, named: the files ZC01FILE / ZC01KEY are defined by zECS's IDCAMS jobs (ZECSFILE.idcams, ZECSKEY.idcams) with install placeholders in their names, so no scenario can give them records: the expired-record browse ends at its first READ GTEQ (the file is not defined: RESP 12) and 3100-DELETE (DELETE GENERIC of ZC01FILE, DELETE of ZC01KEY) is never run, so those paragraphs are uncovered and unproven. Not reached (refused by name): a template with no URL (type A1: WEB PARSE with URLLENGTH 0, X36, IBM leaves the condition open). EIBFN is not read on a path a scenario takes (the FILE-ERROR text only names it).
